title: PUT /tournaments/:id/live-activity request
description: An iOS Live Activity's own push token (ActivityKit's pushTokenUpdates) on this tournament; `round` is the round it shows now. One per phone and tournament: a later one replaces it. `follows` (revision 10; absent means "round", which is what older servers do whatever is sent) says what the activity is for. "round": the server pushes the round's count as the ContentState {done, total} (games with a result, games; byes are not games) when results come in - at most one update per twenty seconds - and ends the activity once every game has a result. "tournament": one activity for the whole event; the server pushes the current round as the ContentState {round, done, total, phase} - phase is paired (no result yet), playing, complete (every game has a result; it stays so until the next round is paired, which the server then pushes as round n+1, done 0), finished (sent with the end), closed (the tournament was archived or binned; sent with the end) - when results come in, a round is paired or unpaired, or the tournament ends; it ends the activity only when the tournament is finished, archived or binned. An activity iOS has ended (eight hours) is started again by push where the phone gave a push-to-start token (live-activity-start-request.schema.json); the phone then sends that activity's token here. DELETE /tournaments/:id/live-activity forgets it (the app ended it, or the person switched it off).
